description: This Java class 'MessageOnlyLogFilter' implements a simple filter for logging, designed to pass through only log messages while removing metadata like tags and priorities. It is used to streamline log output for easier reading and display, such as on-screen logs in Android applications.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A log filter class that implements the LogNode interface, filtering logs to pass only messages.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the filter with an optional next LogNode to chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Filters the log message by passing only the message part to the next LogNode in the chain, ignoring other metadata.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
